The nbfx Options API provides the pure-JavaFX Options dialog: the FxOptionsPanel SPI, the registry that discovers panels from the layer, and the dialog that runs them.
Panels are declared with @FxOptionsRegistration and discovered from NbFx/Options. FxOptionsDialog shows a category list and the selected panel, with OK / Apply / Cancel driving load, apply and cancel.
The Editor panel toggles line numbers and breadcrumbs.
Other modules add panels for their own settings.
The registry is unit-tested. The API is under development until the MVP freeze.
A JDK is required only to compile; JavaFX is provided by the runtime.
Only com.gluonhq.netbeans.nbfx.options is public.
Panels are read from the configuration filesystem under NbFx/Options.
None.
Reads NbFx/Options, written by the nbfx annotations processors.
NbFx/Options, as above.
Panels persist through the services they configure (for example the editor settings).
Building panels and showing the dialog run on the JavaFX Application Thread.
No code runs on startup.
No code runs on exit.
